# JobQueueOptions.verboseExtended property

Adds message bodies to the verbose tracing.

**Signature:**

```typescript
verboseExtended?: boolean;
```

## Default Value

false

## Remarks

The output includes job payloads, so it may contain whatever personal or secret data your jobs carry — this is a debugging aid, not something to leave on in production. Has no effect unless [JobQueueOptions.verbose](/api/job/latest/job.jobqueueoptions.verbose/) is also enabled.
